technique_name: Write a travel guide for Lapland, Finland.
description: Lapland is an immense and breathtakingly beautiful region that lies largely north of the Arctic Circle in northern Finland. It stretches from Norway to the east and down to Sweden in the west. Lapland is full of snow-filled activities, such as skiing, snowshoeing, snowmobiling, sledding, and ice sculpting.
